inputs.text: [excited] Glip… toh… don. In Greek, "glypto" means carved, sculpted. [proud] And "don" means tooth. The sculpted tooth.
[curious] It looks like a giant turtle?
[happily] It sure looks that way, but it was actually a cousin of the armadillo! [serious] Not a dinosaur either: it lived way later, in the Ice Age, [pauses] in South America.
[curious] Who else lived there with it?
[confident] Megatherium, the giant sloth, [warmly] on the very same continent.
